notes: Named L3 targets (TODO M9.5). One entry = one function to run on one corpus family.
entry.kind=synthetic: a program shipped with tools/l3_harness/runner.py, run on the
reference engine PySh4 (Ghidra/QEMU lazily); it proves the runner/dispatcher path,
NOT a firmware reader verdict. entry.kind=blocked: the reader entry point is not
located, so every run reports BLOCKED (exit 4) and no verdict is claimed.
VAs are guest addresses of the synthetic program, never a fitted image delta.
corpus.path is relative to a corpus root built by tools/l3_harness/corpus.py;
corpus.case/reader must match that manifest entry so the Python verdict can be
checked when the manifest is present.

targets.name: probe-zlib-cmf
targets.what: synthetic SH-4 probe: 2x sprintf, CreateFileW, ReadFile, CloseHandle

stubs.note: builds the ANSI path used in the log line (%s)
one byte into the read buffer, count at frame+12; arg 5 at 0(r15)
the handle is closed before the log line is formatted

expect.rule: first served byte is 0x78, the zlib CMF every .cmp stream starts with; the probe is a pipeline fixture, not the firmware container reader

notes: Positive control: the same input the Python cmp_ind reader accepts, served
through the virtual FS and the stub dispatcher.
The probe does not implement the full SH-4 ABI (r8-r13 are not saved); it is
registers-and-memory deterministic, not a compiler output.

targets.name: hddinfo_compare

entry.reason: the HDD_INFO parser is reached through a runtime COM object; only the SD Import/HDD_INFO literals are located in Navi.exe (C-521) and no entry VA exists (M2.1-M2.3)

expect.rule: an unmodified HDD_INFO.TXT must keep the map code accepted; the firmware side is BLOCKED until the parser is located

notes: The retired map-code comparator chain is BT_MGR.dll code (C-520, C-528) and
must not be used as this target.

targets.name: cmp_ind_reader

entry.reason: no .cmp/.ind reader entry point has been located; map filenames have zero literal references and the reader must be found from the CE ROM TOC (M3)

expect.rule: the factory pair must be accepted; corrupt-ind and truncated cases in the manifest must be rejected

notes: The probe-zlib-cmf target exercises the same input path through the stubs
but is not this reader.

targets.name: tile_reader
targets.what: MAPAL001 BxxRyyR.DAT tile reader (MESH_ID/DIVID, 0x1ac level table)

entry.reason: no tile reader entry point has been recovered (M3)

expect.rule: the factory tile must decode; a first byte other than 0x78 is not evidence either way, the tile is not a zlib stream at offset 0

notes: Do not point probe-zlib-cmf at this file and call the REJECT a reader verdict.

targets.name: drstr_parser

entry.reason: entry VA sub_00419350 (Navi.exe 0x00419350, M3.10) lies in the executable, uncompressed sec0, but its coredll imports and buffer global sit in compressed sec1 (0x0055d000): the first read, 0x0055d8fc, is UNMAPPED (EXP-2026-11-08-M9.14-reopen); unblock: M1.2f, then M9.24

expect.rule: the factory tree must parse; the size-mismatch tree in the manifest must be rejected

notes: The reader's CRT calls are coredll fopen/fread/fseek/ftell/ferror/clearerr/fclose (M3.10 decode, wrappers sub_0041b3bc/sub_0041b4f8/sub_0041b470), not CreateFileW/ReadFile; the stub list below is not the reader's call list and is kept only until M9.24 replaces it.
Verdict rule not established: sub_00419350 returns error codes 26/23/20/10 (M3.10), so no verdict_map is written; the 40 | size and size/40 >= 200 checks are unreconciled.

targets.name: mapcode_comparator
targets.what: retired map-code comparator chain (Sys[...] vs SD[...])

entry.reason: the chain 0x6fab2c -> 0x6faeb0 -> 0x6fb05c is BT_MGR.dll code, not the map-code check (C-520, C-528); no runnable target exists, do not revive it

expect.rule: recorded only to keep the retired lead blocked; it must never be presented as a reader

notes: Kept as a BLOCKED entry so a future run cannot silently resurrect the
retired BT_MGR chain as if it were the map-code check.
